videos.title: Property Brothers
videos.description: With twin toddlers, ex-marine Joe and Jessie outgrew their cramped Nashville condo before they moved in. And now the search is on for a farmhouse-style home where they'll have plenty of room to grow.

videos.title: Property Brothers
videos.description: Monique and coach Carl have been house hunting for five long years. Luckily, they don't have that kind of time, and with their lease up in only two months, it's time to get decisive.

videos.title: Property Brothers
videos.description: Since they sold their downtown condo, Leslie and Tim have been living with her parents. And though they both agree it's time to move into a home of their own, she prefers the city while he wants to live in the burbs.

videos.title: Property Brothers
videos.description: Stephanie and Marc are getting frustrated with their house hunt. They've been outbid on a series of properties in the city, and the Property Brothers try to sell them on a radically different approach.

videos.title: Property Brothers
videos.description: Along with their three small children, Debra and Dan are squeezed into a tiny urban condo. And though they'd prefer to stay in the heart of the city, it's time to find the sprawling suburban home of their dreams.

videos.title: Property Brothers
videos.description: Confined to a tiny home in a hot neighborhood, Katie, Michael, and their three daughters quickly sold their property. But now they're squeezed into a one-bedroom rental until the Property Brothers can find them their forever home.

videos.title: Property Brothers
videos.description: Busy parents Kevin and Shirley desperately want to cut down their daily commute so they can spend more time with their daughters and one another. But they sold the house they loved more quickly than anticipated, and now they're stuck in rental limbo.

videos.title: Impossible Builds
videos.description: Jamie Feilden's 60-acre farm doubles as a charity for urban youth. To fund it, he now plans two prefabricated elliptical cabins on a remote slope. They'll feature timber decks, open-plan living, and green roofs—though weather may delay the build.

videos.title: Impossible Builds
videos.description: Paul and Trent want to escape their busy lives to a 600-acre conservation property.

videos.title: Impossible Builds
videos.description: Sarah and Adam swap caravan life for their dream home in rural Cornwall.

videos.title: Impossible Builds
videos.description: Builder Justin and wife Emma tackle an ambitious modular home build on Scotland's remote North Uist.

videos.title: Impossible Builds
videos.description: After years traveling through Europe, Iain and Alyson are ready to put down roots. Their search takes them to Inner Hebridean Island of Skye where they purchase a remote half acre plot, but building a traditional house is a challenge.

videos.title: Impossible Builds
videos.description: Delaval and Veronica are restoring 450 acres for conservation and funding it by building a treehouse in Swanton Novers Wood. A Scottish firm constructs it in 7 sections to minimize damage to the woodland habitat on delivery.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: France & Marc's home is being outgrown by their sport-obsessed sons and provides no inspiring space for France to work from home. Brian and Sarah convert a rundown garage into a spot where France can work and carved out safe sports areas.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Tina and her husband Patrick have a home that is overrun with both baking supplies and soccer equipment. To extend this family's living space, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into one part cake decorating studio and one part soccer field.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Since having two kids, Sonia and Peter have resorted to staycations at home, but their backyard is a headache. Brian and Sarah create a luxury vacation destination that includes a pool, spa, outdoor kitchen and a stunning four-season structure.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Bachelor Kyle's father Jack has helped him renovate his new home, but the backyard is still unusable. To help Kyle throw the ultimate housewarming party, Brian and Sarah build a sexy sports pub, a lounge area and a fire pit.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Kirsten works from the home office, while Joel is a sales representative with a make-shift workspace in their bedroom. To help this couple, Brian and Sarah look to the backyard for space to retrofit an old shipping container into an office.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Ex-city slickers, Lauren and Mark, miss their friends and family from the city. Brian and Sarah create a country retreat with an outdoor pad, indoor dining lounge, and a chicken coop. When Lauren and Mark's friends visit, they'll never want to leave.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Amy & Terry love nothing more than spending time outside with their daughters. Brian and Sarah build a dream enclosure to hang out in on summer nights, with a swimming pool change room and a new deck where Terry can grill.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Nicole and Charles have 3 kids, and their neighborhood parties are getting too big for their front porch. So Brian and Sarah add more entertaining space in the backyard, plus a 4-season garage conversion with a nautical theme.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Sandra & David's eldest daughter, Harlow, was born with vision challenges and their youngest daughter, Delilah, is just learning to walk. Brian and Sarah build a colorful playland for both children, while also building a decked out BBQ & dining area.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Cool parents, Michelle and Adrian, are passionate about music and events. Brian and Sarah tune into their needs and amp up their boring backyard with a DJ den, a creative arts-and-crafts wall, and hang-out zones for family jam sessions.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Jenn and Josh don't have enough space in their semi-detached home to enjoy their hobbies. Brian and Sarah build a stylish lounge space and convert the existing garage into a multipurpose space for crafting and playing guitar.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Steve and Tanya are Realtors who just bought their forever home a few doors down from Tanya's parents. To complete their dream home, Brian and Sarah build a dream cottage retreat in their backyard.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Love is large, but space is tight for Lara & Mike and their 5 children. Brian and Sarah free up space by building an activity-packed tree house and recreation court for the children, with grilling, dining and lounging areas for the whole family.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Paris lovers, Louise and Rick, want to share their European enthusiasm with their two daughters without racking up the mileage. Brian and Sarah build them a French-inspired urban escape. It's Paris in their backyard! C'est magnifique!

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Medical doctors and busy parents, Cynthia and Boon miss their camping adventures. Brian and Sarah perform some backyard surgery, and build them a cozy campground retreat so they can go straight from the ER to getting some R&R right in their own yard.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Dave and Jorge love art and entertaining, but with tenants in their basement and no creative space inside, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into a creative party lounge and build a shipping container-inspired structure for an industrial feel.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Sham, Ruban and their twin boys aren't using their big, boring backyard. To help this family embrace the great outdoors, Brian and Sarah build a vacation style getaway, with a beach volleyball court and a kid's clubhouse.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Debbie, Kevin, and their three children are a newly-blended family. To bring this new family together, Brian and Sarah build an irresistible treehouse village in their backyard.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Matt, Mary and their 2 kids don't use their backyard because the neighboring ravine has taken over. Brian and Sarah face environmental challenges to create a beautiful, entertaining and play space for the whole family to enjoy.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Sonia & Paul are big social connectors in their community with a constant flow of visitors. Brian and Sarah turn their barren backyard into a social hotspot, complete with sunroom, giant chessboard, waterfall and stylish outdoor entertainment spaces.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Breanna & Nick's life revolves around socializing and physical activity. Brian and Sarah convert an old, underused shed into a beautiful, zen'd out yoga studio and create backyard partying, lounging and dining areas.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Carly & Nate's social media star dog, Dean the Basset Hound, has a lot of four-legged friends visiting, leaving the home feeling cramped. Brian and Sarah make a bar/lounge for pet and owner gatherings, along with a stylish outdoor entertainment area.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Andrea and David are foodies, but hosting in their "builder basic" yard is no fun. Brian and Sarah make their farm-to-table dreams come true, with a veggie garden, dining room, BBQ zone, and a play space for their 2 kids.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Melissa and Lee's 3 boys need more room for sports, and Mom needs more peace and quiet! So Brian and Sarah turn the underused backyard into a sports court, a new lounge space, and a luxurious, 3-season Mom's retreat.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Janet's love for her nine grandkids is endless. But so is the chaos they bring inside her home when they come visit. To take that energy outside, Brian and Sarah build a fun kid-zone in the backyard, but also a sophisticated adult area for Janet.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Couple Farzana & Reyan have maxed out all living space in their city-sized bungalow, leaving no room for Reyan's at-home stained-glass business or Farzana's writing. Brian and Sarah build Reyan a spacious studio and construct an inspiring deck area.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Susan's energetic son, Harrison, has no space to dance at home without getting under his mom's feet. Brian and Sarah build a hang-out / dance space for Harrison and create a California-inspired pool and lounge area for Susan.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Tammy and Sam are so busy, their backyard has fallen into disrepair and their 2 kids never use it. Brian and Sarah bring this yard back to life, and then some, with a new dining and lounge area and a fully functional pool house.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Mom and son duo, Paul and Catharine, are overwhelmed by Paul's multi-level backyard. Paul also finds his current indoor fitness regime frustrating. Brian and Sarah muscle up to the challenge by building a gym in his backyard, alongside a hot tub.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: H and her tenant Emma are bursting out of their 3-unit home. To help out both landlord and tenants, Brian and Sarah add storage space, plus a common lounge space in the backyard, with some urban inspired design touches.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Lynna is a single mom with three teenage kids and the time has come for her to have the back garden of her dreams. Brian and Sarah deliver in spades, with a 3 season hang-out, lush new landscaping, and a beautiful greenhouse.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Brian and Sarah build a sun deck, outdoor dining area and a Grecian inspired, 3-season garage conversion.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Jon, Trish, and their two children live in a quintessential family-friendly neighborhood. To give the whole community an outdoor space to enjoy, Brian and Sarah build an outdoor movie theater in their backyard.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Miriam and Mark are busy parents to four kids under 10 years old. To help these hardworking parents unwind, Brian and Sarah build them a parents-only hideaway in their backyard.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Ali and Hana have two very talented young children - and a very noisy and crowded house. To give everyone in this family their own space, Brian and Sarah turn an old garage into a kids' music and arts hangout.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Brian and Sarah create a backyard for Pam & Kevin that matches their lush forest surrounding complete with a double wrap around deck and a hot tub. The team also build a workshop for Kevin to perfect his craft of leather tooling.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Aarati & Dave both work from home, forcing their living room to be a triple duty working/living/children's play area. Brian and Sarah create a flexible structure, install a sleek and sophisticated plunge pool, and create an outdoor fireplace lounge.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Craig and Claudia share their new space with Craig's brother, Craig's parents - and their two massive dogs. To give these new homeowners a place of their own, Brian and Sarah build a sports bar and entertainment hangout in their backyard.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Becki, Shawn and their 3 kids just moved from the city to a smaller country home. To extend their living space, Brian and Sarah build a new deck, a fire pit area, and a 3-season living space, in their first ever barn rehab.

videos.title: Backyard Builds
videos.description: Marlow, Phil, their 3 small kids, and Phil's parents all live in one crowded house. Brian and Sarah transform their yard into a spectacular space for cooking, entertaining and playing.
